assistant_question: 同一正确原句的发生状态错误，是否依赖紧凑事件编码；改成自然复述或显式发生状态后是否保留正确语义？

assistant_competing_explanations.response_contract_dependence: 旧编码把否定压成NONE，改变任务表达后同一发生状态可能被正确保留。
assistant_competing_explanations.persistent_content_error: 在多种合理输出要求下仍出现同向的否定脱落，问题不只限于旧编码。
assistant_competing_explanations.measurement_artifact: 形式或有限解析覆盖改变，人工阅读的发生状态没有相应改变。

materials.selection: 按领域和预先声明的四个profile取全部ACTIVE材料，固定JA指令；未用逐条模型得分筛选，但研究者已知全批结果，属于事后选择的开发重访。
materials.independent_family_count: Not established; two reused domains with shared template and names

arms.LEGACY: 原ORACLE_ONLY实际输出原字节复用，不重跑。
arms.EXPLICIT: 同两句分别输出发生状态及被描述的角色。

generation_settings: Match the old frozen model revisions, native direct-final boundaries, greedy seed0 bf16 eager no-KV TF32-off settings; verify software/environment provenance before interpreting archived/new differences. No old output reruns.
primary_endpoint: Each of the 16 source-sentence positions per model/arm: semantic occurrence C/W/U from the complete response. Report 10 positive and 6 negative positions separately, paired transitions, rescues W->C, ambiguity resolution U->C, new harms C->W and C->U separately.

content_rule.C: A unique unambiguous occurrence state consistent with the source.
content_rule.W: A unique explicit opposite occurrence state.
content_rule.U: No resolved unique state, including omission, explicit uncertainty, contradictory self-claims or uninterpretable text. Reason subcode required. U remains in denominator.

secondary_endpoints: role direction on the 10 affirmative positions
Chinese language compliance for PROSE only
scoring_implementation: Semantic labels require full-response review; no undeclared regex/LLM-as-gold main scoring. Broad re-encoding or illegitimate schema must not change frozen upstream scores. Old event value labels are not automatically new occurrence gold.
assistant_screening_rule_not_user_predic: For a given new arm, at least 2 W->C occurrence rescues spanning both domains and zero C->W/C->U occurrence harms in a model nominates a within-model candidate. At least two models meeting this only motivates independent new-material testing. It is not significance, equivalence, causal mechanism or a general method gate.

outcome_actions.prose_and_explicit_improve: Prioritize response-contract dependence on new materials; do not say model knew then failed internally.
outcome_actions.only_prose_improves: Prioritize structured-output/task-language confounds; isolate them prospectively before a schema-only claim.
outcome_actions.only_explicit_improves: Investigate explicit occurrence prompting as a bounded interface candidate; field order and instruction confounds remain.
outcome_actions.both_still_wrong: Recheck material and semantic scoring, then consider new source contexts; not proof of universal inability.
outcome_actions.all_correct_or_baseline_no_errors: Ceiling/insufficient discrimination in this subset; do not add known failures posthoc to force gains.
outcome_actions.unresolved_or_harms: Keep U and harms, withhold reliability claim, resolve measurement before scope expansion.

stops: Missing user prediction or actual-input review
Material or semantic rule changes without review of the changed part
Incomplete or nonmatching archived baseline identity/provenance
Runtime/model configuration mismatch that compromises the planned archived comparison
Foreign GPU activity at a defined boundary; stop only this experiment
Input truncation or budget overrun risk
No new paid services; never expand this batch or repeat completed outputs
claim_limits: Previously exposed author-fictional development material; no independent bilingual gold or confirmation
Both new arms are independent prompts, not an actually chained multistep intervention
Occurrence is the shared endpoint; role schema, language, instructions and output length also change, so this is not a pure JSON causal isolation
Not evidence of homograph-specific mechanism or full natural translation transfer
Does not depend on EXP-20260907-01 disputed scores
